```{r}

# PCA-based hotspot indices for macro- and micronutrients


library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(vegan)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

set.seed(123)


# Shared colour palette for all figures


pal_main <- c(
  "control" = "#053B45",
  "nest"    = "#B8AA50"
)
###

run_hotspot_index <- function(data, vars, group_label, title_prefix,
                              min_explained = 0.80) {
  
  vars <- intersect(vars, names(data))
  
  dat_index <- data %>%
    select(sample_type, nesting_site, all_of(vars)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  X_index <- dat_index %>%
    select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), log1p)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  X_index <- X_index[, apply(X_index, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  vars_used <- colnames(X_index)
  X_index_scaled <- scale(X_index)
  
  pca_index <- prcomp(X_index_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  
  prop_var <- (pca_index$sdev^2) / sum(pca_index$sdev^2)
  cum_var <- cumsum(prop_var)
  
  k <- which(cum_var >= min_explained)[1]
  if (is.na(k)) k <- length(prop_var)
  
  pc_cols <- paste0("PC", seq_len(k))
  
  pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_index$x[, seq_len(k), drop = FALSE])
  colnames(pc_scores) <- pc_cols
  
  dat_index_pca <- bind_cols(
    dat_index %>% select(sample_type, nesting_site),
    pc_scores
  )
  
  weights <- prop_var[seq_len(k)]
  weights <- weights / sum(weights)
  
  pc_mat <- as.matrix(dat_index_pca %>% select(all_of(pc_cols)))
  control_idx <- which(dat_index_pca$sample_type == "control")
  control_centroid <- colMeans(pc_mat[control_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  
  diffs2 <- (pc_mat - matrix(control_centroid, nrow = nrow(pc_mat), ncol = k, byrow = TRUE))^2
  index_dist <- sqrt(diffs2 %*% weights)
  
  dat_index_pca <- dat_index_pca %>%
    mutate(hotspot_index = as.numeric(index_dist))
  
  fit_hotspot <- lm(
    hotspot_index ~ sample_type + nesting_site,
    data = dat_index_pca
  )
  
  hotspot_result <- broom::tidy(fit_hotspot) %>%
    filter(term == "sample_typenest") %>%
    mutate(
      index_type = group_label,
      median_control = median(dat_index_pca$hotspot_index[dat_index_pca$sample_type == "control"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nest = median(dat_index_pca$hotspot_index[dat_index_pca$sample_type == "nest"], na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = case_when(
        estimate > 0 ~ "higher_in_nest",
        estimate < 0 ~ "lower_in_nest",
        TRUE ~ "no_difference"
      ),
      n_samples = nrow(dat_index_pca),
      n_vars = length(vars_used),
      pcs_retained = k,
      variance_explained = sum(prop_var[seq_len(k)])
    )
  
  pc1_var <- round(100 * prop_var[1], 1)
  pc2_var <- round(100 * prop_var[2], 1)
  
  scores_index_2d <- as.data.frame(pca_index$x[, 1:2]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = dat_index$sample_type,
      nesting_site = dat_index$nesting_site
    )
  
  p_pca <- ggplot(scores_index_2d, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "composition"),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal"
    )
  
  p_index <- ggplot(
    dat_index_pca,
    aes(x = sample_type, y = hotspot_index, colour = sample_type)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "hotspot index"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Distance from control centroid"
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
  
  list(
    dat = dat_index_pca,
    model = fit_hotspot,
    result = hotspot_result,
    pca_plot = p_pca,
    index_plot = p_index
  )
}

macro_index <- run_hotspot_index(
  data = dat_nc,
  vars = macro_vars,
  group_label = "macro",
  title_prefix = "Macronutrient"
)

micro_index <- run_hotspot_index(
  data = dat_nc,
  vars = micro_vars,
  group_label = "micro",
  title_prefix = "Micronutrient"
)

write_csv(macro_index$dat, "Table_macronutrient_hotspot_index_per_sample_2024.csv")
write_csv(micro_index$dat, "Table_micronutrient_hotspot_index_per_sample_2024.csv")
write_csv(macro_index$result, "Table_macronutrient_hotspot_index_model_2024.csv")
write_csv(micro_index$result, "Table_micronutrient_hotspot_index_model_2024.csv")


```



```{r}

# dbRDA: nutrient gradients explaining 16S community structure


library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(janitor)

set.seed(123)


# 1) Match 16S samples to nutrient data

otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_final), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_final)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}
otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ps_rowname")

meta_16s <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ps_rowname") %>%
  mutate(sample_name = as.character(nest_ID))

nutrient_full <- dat_nc %>%
  mutate(sample_name = as.character(slbez)) %>%
  select(
    sample_name,
    sample_type,
    nesting_site,
    all_of(intersect(c(macro_vars, micro_vars), names(dat_nc)))
  )

comm_df_full <- otu_mat %>%
  left_join(meta_16s %>% select(ps_rowname, sample_name), by = "ps_rowname") %>%
  inner_join(nutrient_full, by = "sample_name")

comm_full <- comm_df_full %>%
  select(starts_with("ASV_")) %>%
  as.matrix()

keep_full <- rowSums(comm_full) > 0
comm_full <- comm_full[keep_full, , drop = FALSE]

env_full <- comm_df_full[keep_full, ] %>%
  select(sample_name, sample_type, nesting_site, all_of(intersect(c(macro_vars, micro_vars), names(comm_df_full))))

comm_hel_full <- decostand(comm_full, method = "hellinger")


# 2) Forward selection: macronutrients

macro_candidates <- intersect(macro_vars, names(env_full))

keep_macro <- complete.cases(env_full[, c("nesting_site", macro_candidates), drop = FALSE])
comm_macro <- comm_hel_full[keep_macro, , drop = FALSE]
env_macro  <- env_full[keep_macro, , drop = FALSE]

mod0_macro <- capscale(
  comm_macro ~ Condition(nesting_site),
  data = env_macro,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod1_macro <- capscale(
  as.formula(
    paste0(
      "comm_macro ~ ",
      paste(sprintf("log1p(`%s`)", macro_candidates), collapse = " + "),
      " + Condition(nesting_site)"
    )
  ),
  data = env_macro,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod_sel_macro <- ordiR2step(
  mod0_macro,
  scope = formula(mod1_macro),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  R2scope = TRUE,
  trace = TRUE
)

anova_macro_overall <- anova(mod_sel_macro, permutations = 999)
anova_macro_terms   <- anova(mod_sel_macro, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
anova_macro_axes    <- anova(mod_sel_macro, by = "axis", permutations = 999)

anova_macro_overall
anova_macro_terms
anova_macro_axes

# 3) Forward selection: micronutrients (sensitivity analysis)

micro_candidates <- intersect(micro_vars, names(env_full))

keep_micro <- complete.cases(env_full[, c("nesting_site", micro_candidates), drop = FALSE])
comm_micro <- comm_hel_full[keep_micro, , drop = FALSE]
env_micro  <- env_full[keep_micro, , drop = FALSE]

mod0_micro <- capscale(
  comm_micro ~ Condition(nesting_site),
  data = env_micro,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod1_micro <- capscale(
  as.formula(
    paste0(
      "comm_micro ~ ",
      paste(sprintf("log1p(`%s`)", micro_candidates), collapse = " + "),
      " + Condition(nesting_site)"
    )
  ),
  data = env_micro,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod_sel_micro <- ordiR2step(
  mod0_micro,
  scope = formula(mod1_micro),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  R2scope = TRUE,
  trace = TRUE
)

anova_micro_overall <- anova(mod_sel_micro, permutations = 999)
anova_micro_terms   <- anova(mod_sel_micro, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
anova_micro_axes    <- anova(mod_sel_micro, by = "axis", permutations = 999)

anova_micro_overall
anova_micro_terms
anova_micro_axes


# 4) Plot function

plot_dbrda_selected <- function(mod, env_df, term_table, title_text) {
  
  site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("row_id")
  colnames(site_scores)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  site_scores <- site_scores %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = env_df$sample_type,
      nesting_site = env_df$nesting_site,
      sample_name = env_df$sample_name
    )
  
  bp_raw <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable_raw")
  colnames(bp_raw)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  bp_raw <- bp_raw %>%
    mutate(
      variable = str_remove_all(variable_raw, "log1p\\(|\\)")
    )
  
  term_pvals <- as.data.frame(term_table) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(term != "Residual") %>%
    transmute(
      variable = str_remove_all(term, "log1p\\(|\\)"),
      p_value = .data[["Pr(>F)"]]
    )
  
  bp_scores <- bp_raw %>%
    left_join(term_pvals, by = "variable") %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = recode(variable, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = variable)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value), p_value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      CAP1 = CAP1 * 1.15,
      CAP2 = CAP2 * 1.15,
      lab_x = CAP1 * 1.10,
      lab_y = CAP2 * 1.10
    )
  
  eig_vals <- eigenvals(mod)
  axis1 <- round(100 * eig_vals[1] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  axis2 <- round(100 * eig_vals[2] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  
  ggplot(site_scores, aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bp_scores,
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.20, "cm")),
      linewidth = 0.9,
      colour = "grey30",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = bp_scores,
      aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = variable_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.8,
      linewidth = 0,
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
      colour = "grey15",
      label.r = unit(0.12, "lines"),
      label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines")
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = paste0("dbRDA1 (", axis1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("dbRDA2 (", axis2, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
}

p_dbrda_macro_sel <- plot_dbrda_selected(
  mod = mod_sel_macro,
  env_df = env_macro,
  term_table = anova_macro_terms,
  title_text = "Microbial community constrained by macronutrients"
)

p_dbrda_micro_sel <- plot_dbrda_selected(
  mod = mod_sel_micro,
  env_df = env_micro,
  term_table = anova_micro_terms,
  title_text = "Microbial community constrained by micronutrients"
)

write_csv(broom::tidy(anova_macro_terms) %>% clean_names(),
          "Table_dbRDA_macronutrient_terms_selected_2024.csv")

write_csv(broom::tidy(anova_micro_terms) %>% clean_names(),
          "Table_dbRDA_micronutrient_terms_selected_2024.csv")
```

```{r}

# Mechanism: reproductive parameters and key macronutrients
# + adjusted figure for failed eggs vs sodium and sulfur


library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)


# 1) Prepare analysis data

dat_nc2 <- dat_nc %>%
  mutate(
    nest_depth = to_numeric_comma(nest_depth),
    total_egg_number = to_numeric_comma(total_egg_number),
    egg_number_hatched = to_numeric_comma(egg_number_hatched),
    egg_number_undeveloped = to_numeric_comma(egg_number_undeveloped),
    failure_unknowncause = to_numeric_comma(failure_unknowncause),
    hatching_rate = to_numeric_comma(hatching_rate),
    emergence_rate = to_numeric_comma(emergence_rate),
    failed_eggs = if_else(
      is.na(egg_number_undeveloped) & is.na(failure_unknowncause),
      NA_real_,
      rowSums(cbind(egg_number_undeveloped, failure_unknowncause), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    sample_name = as.character(slbez)
  )

dat_nest <- dat_nc2 %>%
  filter(sample_type == "nest") %>%
  mutate(
    failed_eggs = as.numeric(failed_eggs),
    total_egg_number = as.numeric(total_egg_number),
    nest_depth = as.numeric(nest_depth),
    hatching_rate = as.numeric(hatching_rate),
    emergence_rate = as.numeric(emergence_rate),
    na = as.numeric(na),
    s_icp = as.numeric(s_icp)
  )


# 2) Nutrient–nutrient relationship

cor_na_s <- cor.test(
  log1p(dat_nest$na),
  log1p(dat_nest$s_icp),
  method = "spearman"
)

fit_na_vs_s <- lm(
  log1p(na) ~ log1p(s_icp) + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

fit_s_vs_na <- lm(
  log1p(s_icp) ~ log1p(na) + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)


# 3) Reproductive mechanism models

fit_na_failed <- lm(
  log1p(na) ~ failed_eggs + total_egg_number + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

fit_s_failed <- lm(
  log1p(s_icp) ~ failed_eggs + total_egg_number + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

fit_na_hatching <- lm(
  log1p(na) ~ hatching_rate + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

fit_s_hatching <- lm(
  log1p(s_icp) ~ hatching_rate + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

fit_na_emergence <- lm(
  log1p(na) ~ emergence_rate + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

fit_s_emergence <- lm(
  log1p(s_icp) ~ emergence_rate + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)

# optional sensitivity model
fit_na_hatching_full <- lm(
  log1p(na) ~ hatching_rate + total_egg_number + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest
)


# 4) Export summary table

mechanism_table <- bind_rows(
  broom::tidy(fit_na_failed) %>% mutate(model = "na_failed_eggs"),
  broom::tidy(fit_s_failed) %>% mutate(model = "s_icp_failed_eggs"),
  broom::tidy(fit_na_hatching) %>% mutate(model = "na_hatching_rate"),
  broom::tidy(fit_s_hatching) %>% mutate(model = "s_icp_hatching_rate"),
  broom::tidy(fit_na_emergence) %>% mutate(model = "na_emergence_rate"),
  broom::tidy(fit_s_emergence) %>% mutate(model = "s_icp_emergence_rate"),
  broom::tidy(fit_na_hatching_full) %>% mutate(model = "na_hatching_rate_plus_clutch")
)

write_csv(mechanism_table, "Table_mechanism_models_sodium_sulfur_2024.csv")


# 5) Adjusted prediction data for the main figure
# failed eggs as focal explanatory variable

make_effect_df <- function(data, model, xvar, nutrient_label) {
  
  x_seq <- seq(
    min(data[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  )
  
  ref_site <- names(sort(table(data$nesting_site), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  
  newdat <- tibble(
    failed_eggs = x_seq,
    total_egg_number = median(data$total_egg_number, na.rm = TRUE),
    nest_depth = median(data$nest_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    nesting_site = factor(ref_site, levels = levels(data$nesting_site))
  )
  
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  newdat %>%
    mutate(
      fit_link = pred$fit,
      se_link = pred$se.fit,
      fit = exp(fit_link) - 1,
      lwr = exp(fit_link - 1.96 * se_link) - 1,
      upr = exp(fit_link + 1.96 * se_link) - 1,
      nutrient = nutrient_label
    )
}

pred_na <- make_effect_df(
  data = dat_nest,
  model = fit_na_failed,
  xvar = "failed_eggs",
  nutrient_label = "Sodium"
)

pred_s <- make_effect_df(
  data = dat_nest,
  model = fit_s_failed,
  xvar = "failed_eggs",
  nutrient_label = "Sulfur"
)


# 6) Raw point data

points_na <- dat_nest %>%
  transmute(
    failed_eggs,
    nutrient_value = na,
    nutrient = "Sodium"
  )

points_s <- dat_nest %>%
  transmute(
    failed_eggs,
    nutrient_value = s_icp,
    nutrient = "Sulfur"
  )

points_all <- bind_rows(points_na, points_s)
pred_all <- bind_rows(pred_na, pred_s)

line_types <- tibble(
  nutrient = c("Sodium", "Sulfur"),
  line_type = c("solid", "dashed")
)

pred_all <- pred_all %>%
  left_join(line_types, by = "nutrient")


# 7) Plotting function

plot_mechanism_adjusted <- function(points_df, pred_df, nutrient_name, ylab_text) {
  
  pts <- points_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  prd <- pred_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = pts,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = nutrient_value),
      colour = pal_main["nest"],
      size = 4.6,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
      fill = pal_main["nest"],
      alpha = 0.14
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = fit, linetype = line_type),
      colour = pal_main["nest"],
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_linetype_identity() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = nutrient_name,
      x = "Number of undeveloped eggs",
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
}


# 8) Main mechanism figure

p_na_failed_adj <- plot_mechanism_adjusted(
  points_df = points_all,
  pred_df = pred_all,
  nutrient_name = "Sodium",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_s_failed_adj <- plot_mechanism_adjusted(
  points_df = points_all,
  pred_df = pred_all,
  nutrient_name = "Sulfur",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_mechanism_main <- p_na_failed_adj | p_s_failed_adj

p_mechanism_main



# 9) Compact console output

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Mechanism models: sodium and sulfur in nests\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("\nSpearman correlation between sodium and sulfur:\n")
print(cor_na_s)

cat("\nSodium ~ sulfur + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_na_vs_s))

cat("\nSulfur ~ sodium + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_s_vs_na))

cat("\nSodium ~ failed eggs + clutch size + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_na_failed))

cat("\nSulfur ~ failed eggs + clutch size + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_s_failed))

cat("\nSodium ~ hatching rate + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_na_hatching))

cat("\nSulfur ~ hatching rate + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_s_hatching))

cat("\nSodium ~ emergence rate + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_na_emergence))

cat("\nSulfur ~ emergence rate + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_s_emergence))

cat("\nSensitivity model: sodium ~ hatching rate + clutch size + nest depth + site:\n")
print(summary(fit_na_hatching_full))
```

```{r}
# Figure 3: nutrient–microbiome link and mechanism
# A) dbRDA macronutrients
# B) dbRDA micronutrients
# C) Sodium vs failed eggs
# D) Sulfur vs failed eggs

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)


# Helper: pretty dbRDA plot

plot_dbrda_selected_pretty <- function(mod, env_df, term_table, title_text) {
  
  site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("row_id")
  colnames(site_scores)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  site_scores <- site_scores %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = env_df$sample_type,
      nesting_site = env_df$nesting_site,
      sample_name = env_df$sample_name
    )
  
  bp_raw <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable_raw")
  colnames(bp_raw)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  bp_raw <- bp_raw %>%
    mutate(
      variable = stringr::str_remove_all(variable_raw, "log1p\\(|\\)")
    )
  
  term_pvals <- as.data.frame(term_table) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(term != "Residual") %>%
    transmute(
      variable = stringr::str_remove_all(term, "log1p\\(|\\)"),
      p_value = .data[["Pr(>F)"]]
    )
  
  bp_scores <- bp_raw %>%
    left_join(term_pvals, by = "variable") %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = recode(variable, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = variable)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value), p_value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      CAP1 = CAP1 * 1.18,
      CAP2 = CAP2 * 1.18,
      lab_x = CAP1 * 1.12,
      lab_y = CAP2 * 1.12
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lab_x = case_when(
        variable == "na" ~ CAP1 * 2.50,
        TRUE ~ lab_x
      ),
      lab_y = case_when(
        variable == "na" ~ CAP2 * 3.00,
        TRUE ~ lab_y
      )
    )
  
  eig_vals <- eigenvals(mod)
  axis1 <- round(100 * eig_vals[1] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  axis2 <- round(100 * eig_vals[2] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(site_scores, aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = paste0("dbRDA1 (", axis1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("dbRDA2 (", axis2, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
  
  if (nrow(bp_scores) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(
        data = bp_scores,
        aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.20, "cm")),
        linewidth = 0.9,
        colour = "grey30",
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
        data = bp_scores,
        aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = variable_label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3.6,
        linewidth = 0,
        fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
        colour = "grey15",
        box.padding = 0.25,
        point.padding = 0.15,
        segment.color = "grey50",
        segment.size = 0.3,
        min.segment.length = 0,
        seed = 123
      )
  }
  
  p
}


# Helper: adjusted mechanism plot

plot_mechanism_adjusted <- function(points_df, pred_df, nutrient_name, ylab_text) {
  
  pts <- points_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  prd <- pred_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = pts,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = nutrient_value),
      colour = pal_main["nest"],
      size = 4.6,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
      fill = pal_main["nest"],
      alpha = 0.14
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = fit, linetype = line_type),
      colour = pal_main["nest"],
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_linetype_identity() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = nutrient_name,
      x = "Number of undeveloped eggs",
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
}


# A + B: dbRDA plots

p_fig3_a <- plot_dbrda_selected_pretty(
  mod = mod_sel_macro,
  env_df = env_macro,
  term_table = anova_macro_terms,
  title_text = "Macronutrient gradients"
)

p_fig3_b <- plot_dbrda_selected_pretty(
  mod = mod_sel_micro,
  env_df = env_micro,
  term_table = anova_micro_terms,
  title_text = "Micronutrient gradients"
)

# collect legend only once for A + B
p_fig3_top <- (p_fig3_a | p_fig3_b) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center"
  )


# C + D: mechanism plots

p_fig3_c <- plot_mechanism_adjusted(
  points_df = points_all,
  pred_df = pred_all,
  nutrient_name = "Sodium",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_fig3_d <- plot_mechanism_adjusted(
  points_df = points_all,
  pred_df = pred_all,
  nutrient_name = "Sulfur",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_fig3_bottom <- p_fig3_c | p_fig3_d


# Assemble Figure 3

p_fig3 <- p_fig3_top / p_fig3_bottom +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

p_fig3
```
